parameters.jsCode:
const question = $json.question || "";
const q = question.toLowerCase();

const asksChargingStation =
  q.includes("charging station") ||
  q.includes("charging stations") ||
  q.includes("station") ||
  q.includes("stations") ||
  q.includes("charger") ||
  q.includes("chargers") ||
  q.includes("infrastructure");

const asksCountry =
  q.includes("country") ||
  q.includes("countries") ||
  q.includes("nation") ||
  q.includes("region");

const asksSite =
  q.includes("site") ||
  q.includes("sites") ||
  q.includes("installation site") ||
  q.includes("installation_site_id") ||
  q.includes("located") ||
  q.includes("location") ||
  q.includes("locations") ||
  q.includes("where");

const asksHighest =
  q.includes("highest") ||
  q.includes("most") ||
  q.includes("maximum") ||
  q.includes("max") ||
  q.includes("top") ||
  q.includes("largest");

const asksTransport =
  q.includes("transport") ||
  q.includes("transportation") ||
  q.includes("route") ||
  q.includes("routes") ||
  q.includes("shipment") ||
  q.includes("shipping") ||
  q.includes("freight") ||
  q.includes("delivery");

let query;
let params = {
  highestOnly: asksHighest,
};

if (asksChargingStation && asksCountry) {
  query = `
MATCH (cs:ChargingStation)
WHERE coalesce(cs.is_master_record, false) = true
  AND cs.country IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.unit_id IS NOT NULL
WITH
  cs.country AS country_code,
  count(DISTINCT cs.unit_id) AS station_count,
  count(DISTINCT cs.installation_site_id) AS site_count,
  collect(DISTINCT cs.unit_id) AS station_ids
ORDER BY station_count DESC, country_code
WITH collect({
  country_code: country_code,
  station_count: station_count,
  site_count: site_count,
  station_ids: station_ids
}) AS rows
WITH rows,
     CASE
       WHEN $highestOnly = true AND size(rows) > 0 THEN rows[0].station_count
       ELSE null
     END AS max_count
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row, max_count
WHERE $highestOnly = false OR row.station_count = max_count
RETURN
  row.country_code AS country_code,
  row.station_count AS station_count,
  row.site_count AS site_count,
  row.station_ids AS station_ids
ORDER BY station_count DESC, country_code
LIMIT 100
`;
} else if (asksChargingStation && asksSite) {
  query = `
MATCH (cs:ChargingStation)
WHERE coalesce(cs.is_master_record, false) = true
  AND cs.installation_site_id IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.unit_id IS NOT NULL
WITH
  cs.installation_site_id AS site,
  cs.country AS country_code,
  count(DISTINCT cs.unit_id) AS station_count,
  collect(DISTINCT cs.unit_id) AS station_ids
ORDER BY station_count DESC, site
WITH collect({
  site: site,
  country_code: country_code,
  station_count: station_count,
  station_ids: station_ids
}) AS rows
WITH rows,
     CASE
       WHEN $highestOnly = true AND size(rows) > 0 THEN rows[0].station_count
       ELSE null
     END AS max_count
UNWIND rows AS row
WITH row, max_count
WHERE $highestOnly = false OR row.station_count = max_count
RETURN
  row.site AS site,
  row.country_code AS country_code,
  row.station_count AS station_count,
  row.station_ids AS station_ids
ORDER BY station_count DESC, site
LIMIT 100
`;
} else if (asksChargingStation) {
  query = `
MATCH (cs:ChargingStation)
WHERE coalesce(cs.is_master_record, false) = true
  AND cs.unit_id IS NOT NULL
RETURN
  cs.unit_id AS unit_id,
  cs.serial_number AS serial_number,
  cs.product_variant AS product_variant,
  cs.country AS country_code,
  cs.installation_site_id AS site,
  cs.manufacture_date AS manufacture_date
ORDER BY unit_id
LIMIT 200
`;
} else if (asksTransport) {
  query = `
MATCH (t:Transport)
OPTIONAL MATCH (t)-[:FOR_UNIT]->(cs:ChargingStation)
RETURN
  t.transport_id AS transport_id,
  t.unit_id AS unit_id,
  cs.installation_site_id AS site,
  cs.country AS country_code,
  t.route_from AS route_from,
  t.route_to AS route_to,
  t.mode AS mode,
  t.distance_km AS distance_km,
  t.cost_eur AS cost_eur,
  t.status AS status
ORDER BY t.transport_id
LIMIT 200
`;
} else {
  query = `
MATCH (n)
WHERE n:Location
   OR n:Transport
   OR n:ChargingStation
OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[r]-(connected)
RETURN
  coalesce(n.location_code, n.transport_id, n.unit_id, n.id) AS item_id,
  labels(n)[0] AS item_type,
  coalesce(n.display_name, n.location_name, n.route_from, n.unit_id, n.id) AS item_name,
  properties(n) AS properties,
  type(r) AS relationship,
  labels(connected) AS connected_labels,
  coalesce(
    connected.display_name,
    connected.unit_id,
    connected.actor_name,
    connected.material_name,
    connected.id
  ) AS connected_entity
LIMIT 100
`;
}

return [
  {
    json: {
      agent: "logistics_specialist",
      domain: "Logistics Specialist",
      question,
      query,
      params,
      queryDebug: {
        asksChargingStation,
        asksCountry,
        asksSite,
        asksHighest,
        asksTransport,
      },
    },
  },
];
